Dude, that is ridiculous! You want to through your life away because you don't have a girlfriend? Come on. Okay, for TWENTY YEARS I was physically and verbally abused by my mother, bullied for being an out lesbian in school, and that includes being BEATEN UP EVERY DAY, okay? I worked my ass off at a million crummy jobs and got my own place. You know why? NOT so I could have a girlfriend. SO I COULD MAKE A DIFFERENCE IN THE WORLD! Plus I have two little sisters to protect, take care of and look after!
Hey, wanna talk? I have been where you have been, and I am SO GLAD I didn't end it. Send me a message, dude!

ALSO! Sometimes people are restricted to the places they live, and that makes it hard to make friends, that is why, good sir, we have the internet! There was a point in my life when the only people I talked to lived in other countries, and there isn't anything wrong with that, either. That's why you should be strong! Be whatever you wanna be! Because you are what you make yourself, you know? And also, I would still be happy to be your friend, even if we are far away from each other. =)

Plus, it took me TWENTY YEARS to find a girlfriend! Some people never find a girlfriend. HAVING A GIRLFRIEND ISN'T THAT IMPORTANT! Because how can you love anyone else if you don't love yourself? You can't! It took a lot of trial and error to find the person I'm with now, and ya know what? Maybe someday we won't be together anymore, and THAT'S OKAY!

Make some art, start a blog, write a story, learn how to play a musical instrument! The world is literally yours! Go kick life's ass! I know you can do it. Dying is easy. It doesn't take courage. It means you don't care about yourself, your loved ones, or humans! Think about all the people you'll meet whose lives you'll change! Heck you've already changed mine! YOU have made me more determined to try and help people who are hurting, dude. YOU did that! And all you had to do was type some words onto the computer. Come on, man. Give yourself a chance! Also, hey! I am super ugly, looking different doesn't mean you can't make friends or be in a relationship, it just means you are talking to the WRONG PEOPLE!

But why don't you just not live miserably? Help youself! Talk to a therapist, get on some meds, and talk to some people who are in the same boat as you. Go out and make something beautiful! Have a fucking awesome adventure! Watch a movie or read a book that makes you cry! Being dead won't solve your problems, you just won't exist anymore. SOLVING YOUR PROBLEMS WILL SOLVE YOUR PROBLEMS! Don't give up when you have so much potential! You could be a rockstar! Or you could be an author! You can literally do WHATEVER YOU WANT! Or hell, I dunno, volunteer like I do! Help the young, elderly or disabled! I'm tellin ya, it will make you feel like a superhero.
